notes: Statement and definition text changes, same terms: `coeff β P` becomes `P.coeff β` (and likewise for other polynomials) in the definition `LowRed`, the statements of `lowRed_mul`, `mem_span_pow_of_coeff` and `coeff_eq_zero_of_stable`, and inside proofs. The original pinned Mathlib defines `MvPolynomial.coeff m p` as `@DFunLike.coe _ _ _ _ (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff p) m` (Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Basic.lean:513-514); `MvPolynomial.coeff` no longer exists on the target, and `p.coeff m` is that same `AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff p` applied to `m`. Same polynomial and exponent; no assumptions or conclusions are added or removed. In proofs, `MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq` now takes the polynomial explicitly, so `congrFun constantCoeff_eq Q` becomes `constantCoeff_eq Q`, and the now-protected `coeff_add` is qualified.
